items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Have you heard of Colonel Frye March, (musical sounds)? I had to play that sucker.

ctx.x: Not enclosed there’s some money but I am sending you some money.

Man, I got hit in the mouth with a rifle butt and I had to start carrying my weapon man, because it was unbelievable, unbelievable man. I had to -- so this went on for almost a year. I had to figure out a way how to get out of it. Have you heard of Colonel Frye March, (musical sounds)? I had to play that sucker. Plus the fact that I was the bugler so I had to wake the -­
They’re going to make you bugler. Now did you show any proficiency on the instrument?
